author: Lokigh
body:
Hello! I was literally just banned for combat logging straight after fighting DaBaderMC (I think that's how you spell it.) About 30 sec after I fought him he banned me for combat logging. I have noticed recently that sometimes there is a glitch where it says that the player fell into the void when they were actually hit into the void by another player- this has happened many times to me and people fighting me. I am pretty sure this is what happened in this case, and I would like to kindly ask you to check the logs if possible. I have combat logged many times in the past and been punished, I understand that it can be annoying to other players and therefore have stopped doing it last year. Since this appeal is referring to combat logging I would also like to address an issue that I have observed recently. People have been shooting downwards into the void so that it says 'player was shot by player (0 blocks.)' Surely this is counted as combat logging too? By performing this glitch they are able to deny the other player from getting the kill- just like combat logging. I would hope you would be able to address this also, and maybe you could also do something about the glitch where wrong players get the kill or it says that a person falls into the void when they were really hit off (as it happened in my case.) This is a very annoying glitch that is happening more and more frequently, such as in my case. 

Thanks for reading
Lokigh.

P.S If staff actually played public more often then maybe they will be able to realise these glitches exist and not falsely ban people. :)

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

I wasn't the one who witnessed your combat log, it was actually the senior moderator Fouled. I went ahead and punished you for him when he unexpectedly went offline. I don't know the details, so I'll just go ahead and escalate this to him. And by the way, I've attended barely even 4 scrims in my time in the competitive atmosphere since the times are never easy for me, so that remark at the end is both uncalled for and invalid. :>
